prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW landscape 1536x1024 abstract website background: a meticulously constructed modular folded-paper bas-relief. Premium architectural CGI, orthographic overhead view.

A uniform very pale warm citron-ivory background (#edf0d3). Large calm empty space fills the upper-left and left-center. Along the bottom edge and the right edge, a stepped diagonal arrangement of matching large origami pinwheel tiles rises toward the upper-right corner. The decoration occupies the bottom quarter and the right third, leaving the main upper-left area empty. The tiles are cropped naturally by the bottom and right edges. Match this exact spacious composition; no central objects.

CRITICAL DESIGN PRINCIPLE: this is a precisely engineered REPEAT PATTERN, built by duplicating ONE perfectly formed module, never inventing different geometry for each tile. Use a rotated-square diamond grid with a tile diagonal of approximately 300 pixels. All tile centers lie on the same uniform grid. A narrow clear gap of background separates every tile from its neighbors, so they never fuse. Approximately nine full or partial tiles are visible.

The single module is a folded square rotated 45 degrees, with four broad curved triangular paper flaps revolving around one central point like a four-bladed pinwheel. Four identical flaps rotated in exact 90-degree steps. Each flap has one straight radial fold and one broad smooth curled edge. All four flap tips meet cleanly at the exact center. The four outer diamond corners are clean sharp geometric points. Curves are deliberate, continuous and smooth, like identical die-cut paper pieces folded with a jig. Simple shallow relief, easily understood construction. NO extra subdivisions, irregular filler polygons or additional strips between modules.

Every tile has the same clockwise arrangement of inset faces: one muted petrol teal (#568d83), one dusty lavender (#bda9d4), two pale olive-citron (#b4bb83). Outer folded surfaces stay light ivory-citron. The repeated motif must stay consistent even in cropped tiles. Accents are refined, pastel, restrained.

Material is very smooth matte paper with a delicate satin finish. Gentle realistic relief and soft contact shadows, bright diffuse studio light from upper left, subtle broad highlights. Visually warm, airy, tactile, sophisticated. Render like a carefully modeled and inspected CAD sculpture photographed from above, with immaculate physical construction and clean antialiasing.

Keep every seam intentional, straight edges truly straight, every curve smooth, repeated modules identical, layer ordering coherent. No melted surfaces, warped corners, arbitrary crossings, overlapping adjacent tiles, stray fragments, fuzzy lines, thin dangling tips, multiple central vertices, inconsistent fold directions, wrinkled paper, dents, stains, grain, noise, deep shadows, glossy plastic, chrome, rainbow gradients, text, logos, watermark, borders, frames or UI.
